about: The pinned Marlin-2B serving version (W3). `flags` is exactly what serve.sh passes after the image, with ${NAME} for the two settings; `engine_options_digest` is sha256 of their compact JSON with `settings` substituted. tests/w/test_serving.py keeps this file and serve.sh in agreement.

model.registry_oid_equality: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED: needs HF_TOKEN on the serving host (research/workloads/marlin-sop.md §1.3); measure/inventory.sh prints both sides when HF_TOKEN is exported

eos_supplied_by: stop_token_ids on every request (infrx/worker/engine.py MODEL_EOS_TOKEN_IDS); honoured by the pinned image: pending measure/capability.sh

runtime_image.resolved_by: docker buildx imagetools inspect (read-only registry call); sha256 of the raw manifest list equals the digest
runtime_image.pilot_box: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED: the box's image id begins sha256:4cbfd34aac14 (I1B, 12 hex digits); measure/inventory.sh prints the full id, and equality makes digest_source registry_oid_confirmed

settings_status.ENGINE_MAX_NUM_SEQS: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED: the pilot value (contracts limits engine_max_num_seqs); the pilot box ran 32 (I1B). measure/concurrency.sh measures it and the W3 evidence's predeclared rule sets it
settings_status.PROCESSING_CACHE_DIR: proposed for I2B: on the box's NVMe (I1B: /opt/dlami/nvme, 386 G free); the same value for the gateway, the worker and serve.sh

not_passed: the B300 recommendations (--mamba-cache-mode=align, --block-size 128, --media-io-kwargs, --mm-processor-cache-type shm): never measured on the L40S pilot; adopting one is a new serving version (marlin-sop.md D13)
kv_capacity: pending: num_gpu_blocks x block_size as the engine reports them (measure/inventory.sh)
engine_version: pending: GET /version on the pinned image (measure/inventory.sh)
